_about: Facts true of one specific file, kept out of the splitters' code (to-do-list.md, A3). The ICAI compilation holds several laws in one PDF: each part gets its own name, so its units get their own ids (CGST and IGST Rules both have a rule 2). Pages are the PDF's own, 1-based, inclusive; checked by the user in Preview 2026-11-03. Pages left out: 1-19 front matter and index, 20-181 the CGST Act (taken from India Code instead), 182-183 ICAI's notes, 441-442 blank and ICAI's address. Each Act's range starts at its title page, which carries the dates its sections came into force.
